lines.en: My six legs churn quickly.

lines.zh: 甲壳上有彩虹般的色带
lines.en: Rainbow bands run along my shell.

lines.zh: 我沿着一根草茎往下走
lines.en: I travel down a grass stem.
My antennae keep probing ahead.
I slip into a gap between leaves.

lines.zh: 这一片森林是我的路线
lines.en: This forest is my route.

lines.zh: 我扛着比身体大的东西
lines.en: I carry something bigger than myself.
I head for the earth bank.
I pause on a dead twig.
I go around a puddle.

lines.zh: 我的甲上有一点在发亮
lines.en: Something on my shell is faintly glowing.
I move with the column.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮过石面，留下一道彩。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the stone, leaving a rainbow streak.

lines.zh: 前面那只的触角是我路标。
lines.en: The antennae of the one ahead are my signposts.
I cross a patch of moss.
I climb a stalk as tall as my stride.
I stop; my antennae still move.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在阳光下变色
lines.en: My shell shifts colour in the sun.
There is a world inside me.

lines.zh: 我在找一个能打开它的东西
lines.en: I am looking for what will open it.
This body is heavier than it looks.
I crouch on a leaf.
I groom my antennae with a foreleg.
I remember the road and the smells.
I am waiting for a candy.
The sun makes me shine.

lines.zh: 我不急，钥匙在我肚子里
lines.en: No rush; the key is in my belly.

lines.zh: 我肚子里装着一个维度。
lines.en: There's a dimension inside me.
I look up at you.
You are bigger than the whole tree.

lines.zh: 我甲上的颜色你有看见吗
lines.en: Did you see the colours on my shell?

lines.zh: 我肚子里的东西你拿不走
lines.en: You cannot take what is inside me.
I stop at the leaf's edge.

lines.zh: 触角伸出去，碰到你的袖子。
lines.en: My antenna extends and touches your sleeve.
I am small; you will not step on me.
I am right by your hand.
I am not afraid of you.

lines.zh: 我停在叶缘，甲色一变再变。
lines.en: I stop at the leaf edge, my shell shifting color.
I roll over once.
One antenna is bent.
I hide deeper along the vein.
There is a scratch on my shell.
I tuck my six legs in.
This wound does not matter.
I slowly right myself.
I can still crawl on.
My colours have dimmed.
The rainbow ant's shell cracked.
Is that rainbow candy?
My antennae are twitching fast.

lines.zh: 你放在地上，我自己过去
lines.en: Put it down; I will come.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起某个世界
lines.en: That smell reminds me of some world.

lines.zh: 我身体里装着一个随机的维度。
lines.en: A random dimension sits inside me.
This is it, exactly.
My shell is starting to glow.
I will take it back.
That door is about to open.
Stand back, it will make you dizzy.

lines.zh: 你碰到了叶子，我滚了一下
lines.en: You touched the leaf; I rolled.
I grab the vein and hold.
I am so light, I cannot hurt.
I tumble off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴面翻回叶子上。
lines.en: I flip off your boot back onto the leaf.
Do not shake this blade of grass.
My shell has not cracked at all.
You pushed me off course.
I find my direction again.

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我的六条腿乱了步。
lines.en: The leaf shakes and my six legs lose their rhythm.
We speak with our antennae.
I press my head to yours.
This tree is enough for both.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的世界可以给你看
lines.en: I could show you the world in my belly.
But it takes a candy.
We hold this stretch together.
Your shell is bright too.

lines.zh: 两根触角碰一下，方向就定了。
lines.en: Two antennae touch, and the direction is set.
Do not drop out of the column.
There is more ahead.
I lift it with my forelegs.
It is bigger than my whole body.
I shoulder it and go.
It weighs my legs down.
I bite it; not candy.
This cannot go in my mouth.
I will drag it for now.
It is stuck between leaves.
I will take it back.
The column will need it.

lines.zh: 我六只脚一起钉在苔藓上。
lines.en: All six feet pin down into the moss.
My antennae all point at you.
My shell changed colour.
You have come too close.

lines.zh: 触角笔直指着你的鞋尖。
lines.en: My antennae point straight at your boot tip.

lines.zh: 我腹里的世界开始发烫。
lines.en: The world in my belly begins to heat.
This is a road I know well.
I can call many of my kind.
All six legs are planted.
Shift one step back.
Three counts will do.
It is not too late to go.
I track your feet.
When you move, I reposition.
I slip under the leaf.
You cannot see me from above.
I circle along the vein.
My colour changes.
That will make you lose me.
I am one hand's width from you.
I wait for your hand to come down.
I wait patiently.
You finally shifted.
Then I move too.
I bite you with my mandibles.
My mandibles are small, but strong.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上跳到你手上
lines.en: I jump from the leaf onto your hand.

lines.zh: 我挂在你的袖口上不下来。
lines.en: I hang from your cuff and will not let go.

lines.zh: 你甩了两下，我才掉下去
lines.en: You shook twice before I fell.
I have climbed back.
Where I bite will itch.

lines.zh: 我的颚夹住你指尖的皮。
lines.en: My mandibles pinch the skin of your fingertip.
I duck under the leaf's back side.

lines.zh: 我落回叶背，再从侧面咬。
lines.en: I drop to the underside of the leaf and bite from the side.

lines.zh: 甲壳先亮，然后我才钻出土。
lines.en: My shell glows first, then I push out of the soil.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的颜色先露出来
lines.en: The colours on my shell show first.
I shake the soil off my shell.
My six legs find their footing.
My antennae sweep the air twice.

lines.zh: 落叶下面有道我认得的缝。
lines.en: Under the leaf litter is a seam I know.
There is a world inside me.
It is not open yet.
I crawl that way.

lines.zh: 你听见细小的脚步声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear the tiny footsteps?
The leaf burns; I run out.
I fall from a height.
Water covers the whole leaf.
The blast throws the leaf away.
Something grazed my shell.

lines.zh: 那道光照得我甲上全是颜色
lines.en: That light fills my shell with colour.

lines.zh: 我找不到糖，也找不到树汁
lines.en: No candy, no sap.
The thunder flattens me to the leaf.
There is no leaf to grip here.
